name: Shrubs & scrub
description: Woody scrub - Berberis (calafate), Empetrum (murtilla de Magallanes), Gaultheria (chaura), Mulinum, cushion plants and xeric shrubs such as Larrea. Functional group pooling 34 source nodes (24 native, 2 exotic, 8 mixed-origin); rabbit, guanaco, huemul and livestock all browse this layer, and the rabbits feed on its seedlings.
